gold.user: As a Twilio account manager, I want to retrieve a list of all toll-free phone numbers associated with my account so that I can manage them effectively.
gold.ideal: The API should return a JSON array of toll-free phone numbers, including details such as the phone number, friendly name, and status.

gold.user: As a developer, I need to create a new toll-free phone number for my application to handle customer inquiries, ensuring it is properly configured for SMS and voice.
gold.ideal: The API should accept parameters for the new toll-free number and return a JSON object with the details of the created phone number, including its SID and status.
